info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Training API
info.description: The Workforce Training API facilitates the management and retrieval of workforce training programs within an organization. This endpoint allows users to access detailed information about available training initiatives, their schedules, and enrollment options. Typical consumers of this API include human resource managers and training coordinators who need to plan and monitor employee development programs. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their training strategies and ensure access to valuable resources for employee growth.

get.description: This API endpoint allows you to retrieve information about workforce training programs within the human resource management system. It provides comprehensive details to assist organizations in understanding and managing their training initiatives.
